title: Developers Mentoring Other Developers: Practices I've Seen Work Well
summary: Practical frameworks for formal and informal mentorship between engineers, including kickoff meeting structure, mentee preparation techniques, mentor coaching strategies, and organizational support for mentoring relationships.
when-to-read: Read this when you're setting up a mentoring relationship with another engineer or want to improve the quality of mentorship you give or receive. If you're looking for general career advice or how to navigate specific role transitions, consult the engineering-management tag instead, as this article focuses narrowly on the mentoring relationship mechanics.
